text: The weekly World Boss spawn table. Every spawn shows on the right day and time for the reader's own time zone. The times live on one data page, Module:WorldBossData, so a schedule change is a single edit. Usage {{WorldBossTimetable}} layout (optional) picks the look. auto (default) shows seven day columns on wide screens and a day by day list on phones. week always shows the columns and agenda always shows the list. header (optional) is yes by default. Write no to hide the next spawn bar, the time zone and the note above and below the table. The time zone conversion and the next spawn bar need the script of this table in MediaWiki:Common.js. Without it the table shows server time (New York). The pictures are the files Boss_Red_Dragon.png, Boss_Primal_Anthalon.png, Boss_Leviathan.png, Boss_Kraken.png, Boss_Berserker.png and Boss_Random.png. Needs Module:WorldBossTimetable, Module:WorldBossData and Template:WorldBossTimetable/styles.css. The weekly World Boss spawn table, shown in the reader's own time zone. The weekly World Boss spawn table. Every spawn shows on the right day and time for the reader's own time zone. The times live on one data page, Module:WorldBossData, so a schedule change is a single edit.

Usage 

{{WorldBossTimetable}}
  • layout (optional) picks the look. auto (default) shows seven day columns on wide screens and a day by day list on phones. week always shows the columns and agenda always shows the list.
  • header (optional) is yes by default. Write no to hide the next spawn bar, the time zone and the note above and below the table.
  • The time zone conversion and the next spawn bar need the script of this table in MediaWiki:Common.js. Without it the table shows server time (New York).
  • The pictures are the files Boss_Red_Dragon.png, Boss_Primal_Anthalon.png, Boss_Leviathan.png, Boss_Kraken.png, Boss_Berserker.png and Boss_Random.png.
  • Needs Module:WorldBossTimetable, Module:WorldBossData and Template:WorldBossTimetable/styles.css.
